narrative.overview:
The shared lavega.dev "Midnight" world, applied to investing: a near-black canvas, a serif voice for headings, and plain tabular figures. Investing-web and apps/web use the same palette; `apps/web/src/styles/tokens.css` is the palette source and `apps/investing-web/src/styles/tokens.css` re-expresses it as HSL triplets so Tailwind alpha modifiers (`bg-primary/10`) keep working. Do not switch investing to raw hex or var-to-var `@theme` values: alpha modifiers would then silently emit full opacity.

Density is calm and moderate. Panels are separated by tone (midnight, surface, surface-2) and a 12% white hairline, never by shadow. Color is rare and meaningful: coral means act, blue means link, active or focus, green and rose mean gain and loss, amber means caution. Numbers are the content: Geist, tabular, aligned, never decorated.

Visual anti-references: neon crypto-trading dashboards (glow, gradient numbers, gamified color); a small uppercase kicker above a heading; coral used as a selected or active state.
keyCharacteristics: Dark by default (`color-scheme: dark`) with an opt-in light "warm paper" theme; see Themes.
Instrument Serif for the wordmark and titles from 30px up, Geist with tabular numerals for everything else.
Tone-plus-hairline depth; only floating layers cast a shadow.
Coral is the one filled call to action; blue carries links, active state and focus.
Radii follow the lavega.dev scale: pill buttons, 20px cards, 14px tiles.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Coral is the only filled call to action. It is never a selected, active or hover state, a link, or a data series.

rules.name: The Blue Orientation Rule
rules.body: Blue (#0297de) marks links, the active item and keyboard focus. It is never a fill for a primary action.

rules.name: The Gain/Loss Rule
rules.body: Green and rose carry meaning only for gain, loss and problem. Chart series never use green, rose, or the coral hue.

rules.name: The Contrast Rule
rules.body: Every text and semantic token must reach 4.5:1 on midnight, surface and surface-2; `apps/investing-web/scripts/check-contrast.mjs` proves it. Lowest measured: signal blue on surface-2 at 5.00:1; foreground on midnight is 20.23:1, mist on surface-2 is 7.67:1, gain 8.65:1 and rose 7.39:1 on surface-2.

rules.name: The Size Floor Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif is opt-in through the `font-display` class and only at `text-3xl` (30px) and up. Below that its thin, condensed strokes stop reading; use Geist 600. Base `h1`–`h4` are Geist, so a heading without `font-display` is never serif by accident.

rules.name: The One Weight Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif has one drawn weight. The unlayered `.font-display` rule pins it to 400 with `font-synthesis: none`, so a stray `font-semibold` cannot fake a bold smear.

rules.name: The Serif Spacing Rule
rules.body: `.font-display` sets `line-height: 1.12`, `letter-spacing: 0` and `padding-block: 0.04em`. It is unlayered in `tokens.css` so it beats Tailwind `leading-none` and `tracking-tight`, which crop and squeeze the condensed face.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Figures, tables, inputs, small controls and text under 14px are Geist with `tabular-nums` (set on `body`). Instrument Serif has no `tnum`, so it never carries a number.

rules.name: The Tone-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: A resting panel is separated by tone and a 12% white hairline. A resting panel never gets a shadow, glow or gradient.

dos: **Do** use Geist with tabular numerals for every figure, table, input, control and text under 14px.
**Do** keep coral for the single filled CTA and blue for links, active state and focus.
**Do** separate panels with tone and the 12% white hairline.
**Do** show unknown figures as "Unknown" with a reason, never as zero.
**Do** keep serif headings at `line-height: 1.12` with `0` tracking, and build hierarchy from size alone.
**Do** honor `prefers-reduced-motion` for all animation and transitions.
**Do** use the semantic radius tokens (card, tile, chip, pill, frame), not ad hoc values.
**Do** run `check-contrast.mjs` after any palette change; every text token stays at or above 4.5:1 on midnight, surface and surface-2.
donts: **Don't** drift toward neon crypto-trading dashboards: no glow, no gradient numbers, no gamified color.
**Don't** put a small uppercase kicker or eyebrow above a heading.
**Don't** use coral as a selected, active or hover state, or as a chart series.
**Don't** use green or rose except for gain, loss and problem; chart series never use green, rose or coral hues.
**Don't** put a shadow on a resting panel; only floating layers lift.
**Don't** set `leading-none` or `tracking-tight` on serif text, or add bold to it.
**Don't** use the serif below 30px, or for figures, tables or inputs; those are Geist.
